newValues.geometryCoverage: Seven labelled plate controls plus retained typical outlines; bounded additive city-facing tower facade. Roof schedule, exact taller/shorter mechanical profiles and other facade schedules remain unresolved.
newValues.modelCaveat: Existing source-plan shapes and registered tower datums are retained. City-facing piers, spandrels and glazing divisions interpret the official artist concept and August 2025 construction photos; their spacing and relief are approximate. This is an illustrative source-based model, not an as-built survey.
